race.comment: HELL (2) hasn't won for a long time but very rarely turns in a poor performance. Has speed to burn and will look to make all the running in front. DIAMOND EPIC (13) caught eyes first-up when finishing off strongly late at Eagle Farm. Has trialled strongly in-between runs and and has KWT reuniting from a suitable draw. Suspect she will be blending into it at just the right time. TEN DEEP (4) was cut down on the line last time when well supported. Should be at her absolute top now and could be worth another look. SMOKE ON THE WATER (8) has returned in career best touch and is going too good to leave out of the numbers on the quick back-up.
